provenance.author: BoardFlow
sources: Dune: Imperium rulebook (2020-10-26) incl. House Hagal sheet

modules.name: Epic mode
modules.note: Play to 12 VP. Needs Rise of Ix.

modules.name: Bloodlines
modules.note: Some Bloodlines cards are Uprising-only; the steps below say which to leave out.

steps.text: Place the board; Mentat on its side on the Mentat space
Alliance tokens on the marked spots of the Emperor, Guild, Bene Gesserit and Fremen tracks
CHOAM overlay on the board's upper right corner; Ix board beside the board
Shuffle the {n} Tech tiles facedown into 3 stacks on the Ix board; flip the top of each
Shuffle the Ix and Bloodlines Tech tiles into 3 even stacks on the Ix board; flip the top of each
steps.note: No Ixian Embassy board. Leave out CHOAM Transports, Advanced Data Analysis, Forbidden Weapons, Ornithopter Fleet, Panopticon and Spy Drones

steps.text: Ixian Embassy board beside the board; shuffle the Bloodlines Tech tiles into 3 even stacks on it and flip the top of each
steps.note: Leave out CHOAM Transports, Advanced Data Analysis, Forbidden Weapons, Ornithopter Fleet, Panopticon and Spy Drones

steps.text: Bene Tleilax board above the Imperium Row, {n} spice on the 4th space of the Tleilaxu track
Research Station overlay on the Research Station space
Sardaukar Commanders on Conspire, Wealth, Foldspace, High Council and Rally Troops; 1 more in the bank
4 players: another Sardaukar Commander on Hall of Oratory
Sardaukar Commanders on Conspire, Wealth, Foldspace, High Council and Dreadnought; 1 more in the bank
steps.note: The CHOAM overlay covers Rally Troops and Hall of Oratory

steps.text: 4 players: another Sardaukar Commander on Tech Negotiation
Shuffle the Sardaukar Commander Skills without the 2 "Fierce" ones; deal {n} faceup
Add Rise of Ix's Conflict cards to the pool
steps.note: Bloodlines' Conflict cards are Uprising-only; leave them out

steps.text: Conflict deck from the bottom up: {n}; return the rest unseen

amounts.n: 4 random Conflict III, 5 Conflict II, 1 Conflict I

steps.text: Conflict deck from the bottom up: {n}; no Conflict I
Shuffle Rise of Ix's Intrigue and Imperium cards into those decks
Shuffle Immortality's Intrigue and Imperium cards into those decks
Shuffle Bloodlines' Intrigue and Imperium cards into those decks
steps.note: Leave out the Uprising-only cards: False Orders, Grasp Arrakis, Insider Information, Ripples in the Sand, Sleeper Unit, Arrakis Observer, Eliminate Allies, Holy War, Intelligence Training (2), Pointing the Way, Shrouded Counsel, and all CHOAM Module parts

steps.text: Add the Tech Module's 2 Intrigue and 2 Imperium cards
Shuffle the Intrigue deck facedown beside the board
Shuffle the Imperium deck and reveal {n} cards as the Imperium Row
Reserve stacks: Arrakis Liaison, The Spice Must Flow, Foldspace
Reclaimed Forces left of the Bene Tleilax board; shuffle the Tleilaxu deck and deal {n} faceup beside it
Bank of Solari, spice and water beside the board
Leave out Count Hasimir Fenring, Gaius Helen Mohiam and Liet Kynes
Each player takes a Leader
Shuffle your 10-card starting deck facedown left of your Leader
Swap both Dune, the Desert Planet cards for 2 Experimentation
Swap 1 Dune, the Desert Planet for Control the Spice
Take {n} water
Pick a color: 2 Agents on your Leader, Swordmaster beside the board
Score marker on {n}
Combat marker on 0 of the Combat track
A cube on the bottom space of each of the 4 Influence tracks
{n} troops in your garrison, the rest in your supply
steps.ref: Dune p.5, Rise of Ix p.10

steps.text: Take your {n} dreadnoughts; Freighter disc on the bottom of the Shipping track
Tleilaxu and research discs on the leftmost spaces of their tracks; take a Family Atomics token
Each player draws {n} Intrigue card
Pick a color for House Hagal: a cube on the bottom of each Influence track, no troops in its garrison
Remove the 3 Arrakeen cards marked 1P from the House Hagal deck
Also remove both Hall of Oratory and both Rally Troops cards; add Rise of Ix's Hagal cards except the 4 marked 1P
Add Bloodlines' 2 Tuek's Sietch Hagal cards only if someone plays Esmar Tuek
Shuffle the House Hagal deck; its {n} Agents beside it
Pick 2 Leaders for the Rivals (not Paul Atreides or Helena Richese)
steps.note: Rivals use only their Signet Ring ability

steps.text: Each Rival: a cube on the bottom of each Influence track, {n} troops in its garrison, 2 Agents in its supply
Insert both Rival Swordmasters into the Conflict deck with {n} cards above them
House Hagal deck: remove the Reshuffle card and the 3 Arrakeen cards marked 2P, then shuffle
Also remove both Hall of Oratory and both Rally Troops cards; add Rise of Ix's Hagal cards except the 2 Dreadnought cards marked 2P
Swap the 3 Carthag Hagal cards for Immortality's 4; Rival Tleilaxu discs at the start of the Tleilaxu track
steps.note: Rivals don't use the research track

steps.text: Add Bloodlines' 4 Acquire Tech Hagal cards
Add Bloodlines' 2 Tuek's Sietch Hagal cards only if you play Esmar Tuek
Put the 5 Solari token on the Mentat space
steps.note: The Mentat costs 5 Solari this game

steps.text: You also start with 1 Solari and 1 spice
Each Rival draws 1 Intrigue card
The game ends after the round in which someone reaches {n} VP (or the Conflict deck runs out)
steps.ref: Dune p.13, Rise of Ix p.10

steps.text: House Hagal takes a turn after each of the first player's Agent turns
Rivals spend resources for VP as soon as they can
Rivals get their Swordmasters when the Conflict card above them is revealed
After buying a Tech tile, flip the next tile of that stack
Sardaukar Commander: 2 Solari when your Agent visits its space
Pick a random first player; they take the First Player marker
The Rival on your left takes the First Player marker
Reveal the top Conflict card; everyone draws {n} cards
Clockwise: send an Agent, or take your Reveal turn
